title: Balanced Tofu Laksa
subtitle: with Broccoli and Noodles
description: Get ready for some serious slurping action when this irresistible laksa, featuring peanut tofu, broccoli and carrot, hits the dinner table. (And be sure to grab plenty of napkins!)

steps.text: Prep veggies: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Cut the broccoli stem into 1cm chunks (see Did you know?) and cut the head into small florets. Peel the carrot and halve lengthwise, then thinly slice on an angle.
Warm tofu: Heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden. Remove from the pan and cut into 2cm chunks.

Make laksa: Return the pan to medium heat, add the curry powder and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant. Stir in the coconut milk and 375ml (1½ cups) water and bring to the boil. Add the broccoli, carrot, 1 tbs soy sauce and 1½ tsp sugar and stir to combine. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, covered, for 5-8 mins until the veggies are tender.
Cook noodles: Meanwhile, add the noodles to the pan of boiling water and cook for 7 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking.
Serve up: Divide the noodles and tofu among bowls and spoon over the laksa. Enjoy!

Did you know?: You know that neat trick of putting shredded spring onion in iced water to make it curl up? This also works with broccoli stem! Trim the stem, then peel into long thin strands and put in a bowl of iced water until you're ready to serve. Drain, then scatter over the laksa for a chef-style finish.
